evidence_contract: Every numeric field carries its own provenance. A runnable case may combine reported values and explicit assumptions, but it is not promoted back into services.json as an observed facility service.

road_diesel_tractor_defaults.treatment: Sensitivity context only. The default solver retains the official MEE aggregate factor for mode-to-mode comparability.

rail_and_water_gap.treatment: No vehicle-, train- or vessel-specific factor is claimed.

edges.cost_scope: Reported Chongqing-Shanghai 20-foot comparison; exact inclusions and terminal endpoints were not published.
edges.admission_note: Road is on-demand, but mapping city-level endpoints to Guoyuan and Yangshan is a model convention.

service_hours.assumption: 72/96/120 hours remains a conservative 3-5 day road sensitivity band pending a carrier dispatch record; it replaces the earlier cross-corridor proxy but is not promoted as observed.

edges.cost_scope: Reported Chongqing-Shanghai rail comparison applied to the rail leg; adding explicit Shanghai drayage may be conservative if the quote already included it.
edges.admission_note: A 2021 Shanghai official response lists Chongqing among cities connected to Shanghai Port and identifies Luchaogang as the Shanghai endpoint. The exact Chongqing station and current service remain unresolved.

service_hours.assumption: The 55-60-hour evidence is for the historical Yangpu-Tuanjiecun five-fixed train. Applying it to Guoyuan-Luchaogang is an explicit terminal-mapping sensitivity, not proof of a current direct train.

edges.cost_scope: One public spot posting for a loaded single 20-foot container at 17-21 tonnes; not a contracted sea-rail tariff or completed-trip invoice.
edges.admission_note: Shanghai confirms a separate road drayage operation; an industry association reports about 45 km and a 2026 marketplace posting supplies the CNY 200 sensitivity value.

policy_support_context.treatment: reported separately; not subtracted from customer cost

operating_performance_context.scope: reported rail-to-port transfer operations at Luchaogang-related projects
operating_performance_context.limitation: No full dwell or gate-queue distribution is published.

distance_km.assumption: Industry-association route statement; exact terminal gates are not specified.

quoted_cost_cny_per_20ft.assumption: Single public spot posting; used as a central calibration, not a market average or contract rate.

service_hours.assumption: Bridge travel band only; not an observed distribution.

handling_hours.assumption: One-hour central value follows the published performance threshold; the exact rate above 60 percent and distribution are not published.

edges.cost_scope: Operator-reported 2021 Chongqing-Shanghai 20-foot water comparison; exact inclusions and fast-service applicability are not fully stated.
edges.admission_note: Bundled through service. Reported intermediate routing via Waigaoqiao or Taicang is not exposed as a free route-choice node.

quoted_cost_cny_per_20ft.assumption: Used without the previous unsupported ten-percent surcharge; the source is a corridor comparison rather than a sailing quote.

service_hours.assumption: Endpoints are the reported 8-9 day range and central is its midpoint.

edges.cost_scope: August 2025 Chongqing-Shanghai 20-foot FIO export-feeder average; not door-to-door and not a Haohang-specific quote.
edges.admission_note: The current operator reports a ten-day Chongqing-Shanghai run at two sailings per week. The model keeps voyage time separate from unobserved booking wait.

operator_schedule.consistency_note: The page also states about 8000 TEU per month; that headline is not arithmetically reconciled with the weekly route table and is not used by the model.

terminal_process_context.treatment: Reported separately; neither value is added to the ten-day voyage because the route-specific overlap and booking distribution are unknown.

quoted_cost_cny_per_20ft.assumption: Monthly corridor average; not a specific operator quote.

service_hours.assumption: Ten-day route-level disclosure; exact terminals and statistical distribution are not published.

edges.cost_scope: September 2024 FIO external-trade feeder average; not door-to-door.
edges.admission_note: The terminal mapping combines Zhujiangqiao's documented Yangshan-feeder role with city-level Wuhu-Yangshan service and tariff evidence.

service_hours.assumption: The published commitment is at most 60 hours; 48 and 54 hours are sensitivity values, not percentiles.

edges.cost_scope: September 2024 Nanjing-Shanghai FIO average mapped to the later Qiba-Waigaoqiao fast service; not door-to-door.
edges.admission_note: The 25-hour service is current-reference only and passes Longtan without creating a selectable transfer.

service_hours.assumption: Central uses the published 25 hours; 22 and 30 hours are sensitivity values, not an observed distribution.

transfers.admission_note: Historical generic road-rail coefficients are localized to the documented Luchaogang transfer; they are not a measured terminal tariff.

cases.classification: mixed operator-reported, official index, marketplace spot, team-collected distance and explicit remaining assumptions
cases.route_semantics: Road direct; rail then Luchaogang-Yangshan road drayage; bundled express water; bundled regular water.

cases.classification: current-reference feeder calibration; not a 2022 tariff snapshot
cases.route_semantics: Single documented feeder family with a modelled terminal mapping.
